findings.claim: Q2 report (2026-07-29): FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance $3.28–$3.32 vs consensus $3.36; revenue guidance $21.2–$21.4B vs consensus $21.6B; Q3 guide EPS $0.80–$0.82 and revenue $5.2–$5.3B vs consensus $0.84 / $5.4B. Guidance below consensus.
findings.source: MarketBeat, Boston Scientific updates FY 2026 earnings guidance

findings.claim: Company cut 2026 guidance twice: Q1 (Apr 22) organic growth to 6.5–8% from 10–11% and EPS to $3.34–3.41; Q2 (Jul 29) cut again, citing WATCHMAN and US EP. No raise found in 2026.
findings.source: MassDevice, Boston Scientific Q2 2026 cuts guidance

findings.claim: Q3 2026 (reported 2026-10-28): net sales $5.138B, +1.5% organic; adjusted EPS $0.73, below July Q3 guide of 3–5% growth and $0.80–$0.82 EPS. Updated FY/Q4 guidance not retrieved.
findings.source: Finviz/PR Newswire, Boston Scientific announces results for third quarter 2026

findings.claim: Analyst target distribution varies by aggregator: Bullstory (2026-08-19) avg ~$62.69, 29 analysts, range $44–$94; MarketBeat (undated) avg $71.62, 31 analysts, high $118, low $50; Tickflow (Aug 1) avg $82.40. Targets cut after guidance (e.g. Needham to $57 from $77). Ratings still mostly Buy.
findings.source: Bullstory BSX analyst forecast; MarketBeat BSX forecast; Tickflow

note: Excerpts not verbatim from snippets; target as-of mixed across aggregators; post-Q3 (Oct 28) consensus targets not found. Price comparison should use numbers.price_at_dd.
